cachePathMapping.note: The receipt's other cache references (the earlier verdicts and draft revisions r1 to r4, which are history; LC/stack-fix-1/LEAD-DECISIONS.md) stay in the lead cache and are not copied. The earlier verdicts are recorded in each review record's priorVerdicts.

standing: Capture, the inventory-inputs producer and custody assembly share the invocation's one snapshot ledger, with its cumulative usage and failure latch; no ledger is opened for the reread or the seeding. A size pre-check is made once before the producer runs. The avoidable work is removed first. The census of the snapshot ledger is owed, and a lawful repository ending on row 21 is a host defect under LD-DEC-5 items 1, 4 and 8, gating the wiring of analysis to the command line. M3-C r8/r9, the J3d-TS composition's text, MJ row 36 and X5 item 5 are not edited. The numbered statements of the erratum, not this summary, are the requirements.

notBoundOrAccepted.code: The implementing unit's derivation and code: not accepted, not integrated, not qualified. No implementation, price, census, integration or Run gate is accepted.
notBoundOrAccepted.owedElsewhere: The census of the snapshot ledger (before analysis is wired to the command line); the three stop-and-report checks the erratum leaves to the implementing unit (the cap on the planned-program count P by its three bases; whether the returns of a TS2 session that breached its response bound are excluded before fact admission; where the number of TS2 sessions is capped); one owner of the source blobs (R-1); the participants' sealed reads (R-2); the one Open item for the owner's post-M3 list (the structural row names the provider for a host sizing limit)
